40005480.author: पदार्थः
40005480.content: धर्मज्ञः knower of righteous ways, नरर्षभः the best among men, क्रोशादेव from a distance of one krosa, भरद्वाजाश्रमम् Bharadwaja's hermitage, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सर्वम् entire, बलम् army, अवस्थाप्य  brought to a halt, न्यस्तशस्त्रपरिच्छदः lay aside the royal robes and weapons, क्षौमे वाससी silk garments, वसानः wearing, पुरोधसम् with family priest, Vasistha, पुरोधाय placing ahead of him, मन्त्रिभिस्सह along with ministers, पद्भ्याम् एव on foot, जगाम went.

40005480.author: Translation
40005480.content: Bharata, the knower of righteous ways and the best among men, saw the hermitage of Bharadwaja from a distance of one krosa and brought his entire army to a halt. He laid aside all his royal robes and weapons. Clad in silk garments, he went on foot along with his ministers, with the family priest Vasistha ahead of him.

40005481.author: पदार्थः
40005481.content: धर्मज्ञः knower of righteous ways, नरर्षभः the best among men, क्रोशादेव from a distance of one krosa, भरद्वाजाश्रमम् Bharadwaja's hermitage, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सर्वम् entire, बलम् army, अवस्थाप्य  brought to a halt, न्यस्तशस्त्रपरिच्छदः lay aside the royal robes and weapons, क्षौमे वाससी silk garments, वसानः wearing, पुरोधसम् with family priest, Vasistha, पुरोधाय placing ahead of him, मन्त्रिभिस्सह along with ministers, पद्भ्याम् एव on foot, जगाम went.

40005481.author: Translation
40005481.content: Bharata, the knower of righteous ways and the best among men, saw the hermitage of Bharadwaja from a distance of one krosa and brought his entire army to a halt. He laid aside all his royal robes and weapons. Clad in silk garments, he went on foot along with his ministers, with the family priest Vasistha ahead of him.

40005482.author: पदार्थः
40005482.content: ततः then, राघवः scion of the Raghu race (Bharata), तान् मन्त्रिणः those ministers, तस्य भरद्वाजस्य that Bharadwaja's, संदर्शने within sight, अवस्थाप्य halted, अनुपुरोहितम् following his priest जगाम went.

40005482.author: Translation
40005482.content: Then the scion of the Raghu race (Bharata) halted his ministers within sight of Bharadwaja's (hermitage) and went along following his priest Vasistha.

40005483.author: पदार्थः
40005483.content: अथ thereafter, महातपाः the great ascetic, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, अर्घ्यम् इति bring offerings of water, शिष्यान् to disciples, ब्रुवन् saying, तूर्णम् soon, आसनात् from seat, सञ्चचाल moved.

40005483.author: Translation
40005483.content: On seeing Vasistha, the great ascetic Bharadwaja immediately left his seat and said to his disciples, Bring offerings of water.

40005484.author: पदार्थः
40005484.content: महातेजाः radiant Bharadwaja, वसिष्ठेन with Vasistha, समागम्य having met, भरतेन by Bharata, अभिवादितः greeted, तम् him, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, सुतम् as son,  अबुद्ध्यत knew of.

40005484.author: Translation
40005484.content: After meeting Vasistha and greeted by Bharata, the radiant Bharadwaja could recognize he was the son of Dasaratha.

40005485.author: पदार्थः
40005485.content: धर्मज्ञः knower of righteous ways (Bharadwaja), आनुपूर्व्यात् in order, ताभ्याम् to both of them, अर्घ्यं च welcomeoffering, पाद्यं च water for washing feet, पश्चात् thereafter, फलानि च fruits, दत्वा having given, कुले in the family, कुशलम् welfare, पप्रच्छ enquired.

40005485.author: Translation
40005485.content: Offering them both in order arghya (welcomeoffering), water to wash their feet and fruits in accordance with the practice, he enquired Bharata about the welfare of the family.

40005486.author: पदार्थः
40005486.content: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, बले in the army, कोशे in the treasury, मित्रेष्वपि च of the friends also, मन्त्रिषु of the ministers, वृत्तम् wellbeing, जानन् knowingly, राजानम् king, दशरथम् Dasaratha, नोदाहरत् did not mention.

40005486.author: Translation
40005486.content: He enquired about the welfare of Ayodhya, of the army, treasury, friends and the ministers. But knowingly did not mention about Dasaratha's wellbeing (the knew Dasaratha was dead).

40005487.author: पदार्थः
40005487.content: वसिष्ठः Vasistha, भरतश्च also Bharata, एनम् him, शरीरे about his health, अग्निषु his sacred fires, वृक्षेषु his trees, शिष्येषु his disciples, मृगपक्षिषु about animals and birds, अनामयम् well being, पप्रच्छतुः enquired.

40005487.author: Translation
40005487.content: Vasistha and Bharata also enquired about his health and welfare of his sacred fires, his disciples, animals and birds and trees of the hermitage.

40005488.author: पदार्थः
40005488.content: महातपाः the great ascetic, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, तथेति saying so, so, तत् that welfare, प्रतिज्ञाय informing, राघवस्नेहबन्धनात् out of affection for Rama, भरतं प्रति addressing Bharata, इदम् these words, उवाच said.

40005488.author: Translation
40005488.content: Saying, all is well, the great ascetic Bharadwaja, out of his affection for Rama, said to Bharata:

40005489.author: पदार्थः
40005489.content: राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशासतः while ruling over, तव for you, इह here, आगमने in the arrival, कार्यम् reason, किम् what, एतत् all this, सर्वम् completely, मे to me, आचक्ष्व tell, मे to me, मनः my mind, न हि शुद्ध्यते is not clear about it.

40005489.author: Translation
40005489.content: Why have you come here when you ought to be ruling the kingdom? Tell me everything about this. My mind is not clear in this matter.

40005490.author: पदार्थः
40005490.content: अमित्रघ्नम् destroyer of enemies, आनन्दवर्धनम् enhances the delight of, यं that Rama, कौसल्या Kausalya, सुषुवे gave birth, यः that, सभार्यः with his wife, भ्रात्रा सह along with his brother, चिरम् for a long time, वनम् to the forest, प्रव्राजितः has been banished, महायशाः  illustrious, यः असौ that Rama, स्त्री नियुक्तेन urged by a woman, पित्रा by his father, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, वनवासी living in the forest, भव shall become, इति thus, इह here, नियुक्तः has been ordered, तस्य his, अपापस्य sinless, तस्य his, अनुजस्य च brother, पापम्  harm, कर्तुम् to do, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, भोक्तुमनाः to enjoy, इह here, न इच्छसि not intending to do so?

40005490.author: Translation
40005490.content: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?

40005491.author: पदार्थः
40005491.content: अमित्रघ्नम् destroyer of enemies, आनन्दवर्धनम् enhances the delight of, यं that Rama, कौसल्या Kausalya, सुषुवे gave birth, यः that, सभार्यः with his wife, भ्रात्रा सह along with his brother, चिरम् for a long time, वनम् to the forest, प्रव्राजितः has been banished, महायशाः  illustrious, यः असौ that Rama, स्त्री नियुक्तेन urged by a woman, पित्रा by his father, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, वनवासी living in the forest, भव shall become, इति thus, इह here, नियुक्तः has been ordered, तस्य his, अपापस्य sinless, तस्य his, अनुजस्य च brother, पापम्  harm, कर्तुम् to do, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, भोक्तुमनाः to enjoy, इह here, न इच्छसि not intending to do so?

40005491.author: Translation
40005491.content: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?

40005492.author: पदार्थः
40005492.content: अमित्रघ्नम् destroyer of enemies, आनन्दवर्धनम् enhances the delight of, यं that Rama, कौसल्या Kausalya, सुषुवे gave birth, यः that, सभार्यः with his wife, भ्रात्रा सह along with his brother, चिरम् for a long time, वनम् to the forest, प्रव्राजितः has been banished, महायशाः  illustrious, यः असौ that Rama, स्त्री नियुक्तेन urged by a woman, पित्रा by his father, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, वनवासी living in the forest, भव shall become, इति thus, इह here, नियुक्तः has been ordered, तस्य his, अपापस्य sinless, तस्य his, अनुजस्य च brother, पापम्  harm, कर्तुम् to do, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, भोक्तुमनाः to enjoy, इह here, न इच्छसि not intending to do so?

40005492.author: Translation
40005492.content: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?

40005493.author: पदार्थः
40005493.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, भरतः Bharata, दुःखात् with grief, पर्यश्रुनयनः with tears in his eyes, संसज्जमानया with stumbling, वाचा words, भरद्वाजम् to Bharadwaja, प्रत्युवाच ह said in reply.

40005493.author: Translation
40005493.content: At these words, Bharata, eyes filled with tears of grief, replied to Bharadwaja in a   stumbling voice:

40005494.author: पदार्थः
40005494.content: भगवानपि even one venerable like you, माम् about me, एवम् in this way, मन्यते यदि if you think, हतः अस्मि I am done with, मत्तः from me, दोषम् evil, न आशङ्के do not suspect, माम् me, एवम् in this way, न अनुशास्तु हि not rebuke.

40005494.author: Translation
40005494.content: When one so venerable like you too misunderstands me, I am gone. There is no danger for him from me. Do not rebuke me this way.

40005495.author: पदार्थः
40005495.content: मे माता my mother, मदन्तरे in my absence, यत् whatever, अवोचत् said, एतत् that one, इष्टम् to my liking, न च not, एतेन by this, अहम् I, तुष्टश्च pleased, न not, तद्वचनं those words, न आददे I do not accept.

40005495.author: Translation
40005495.content: I do not approve of whatever my mother said in my absence. I am not happy with those words and I do not accept them.

40005496.author: पदार्थः
40005496.content: अहं तु as for me, नरव्याघ्रम् the best among men, Rama, तम् him, प्रसादकः after persuading, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, प्रतिनेतुम् to take him back, तस्य his, पादौ feet, अभिवन्दितुम् च to worship, उपयातः I have come.

40005496.author: Translation
40005496.content: I have come to worship the feet of Rama, the best of men and persuade him to return to Ayodhya.

40005497.author: पदार्थः
40005497.content: भगवन् O Lord, त्वम् you, माम् me, एवंगतम् in these circumstances, मत्वा having considered, प्रसादम् kindness, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि be pleased, महीपतिः lord of the earth, रामः Rama, सम्प्रति now, क्व where, मे to me, शंस tell.

40005497.author: Translation
40005497.content: O venerable one in consideration of the circumstances I am in, be kind to me and tell me the whereabouts of Rama, lord of the earth.

40005498.author: पदार्थः
40005498.content: ततः then, वशिष्ठादिभिः by Vasistha and others, ऋत्विग्भिः by the priests, याचितः besought, भगवान् the venerable one, भरद्वाजः Bharadwaja, प्रसादात् with pleasure, तं भरतम् to Bharata, वचः these words, उवाच said.

40005498.author: Translation
40005498.content: Likewise besought by Vasistha and other priests, the venerable Bharadwaja was pleased to tell Bharata:

40005499.author: पदार्थः
40005499.content: पुरुषव्याघ्रः O best of men, गुरुवृत्ति: conduct towards spiritual preceptors, दमश्चैव control over senses, साधूनाम् of virtuous people, अनुयायिता following, एतत् all this, राघववंशजे born in the Raghu race, त्वयि in you, युक्तम् is appropriate.

40005499.author: Translation
40005499.content: O best of men (Bharata) your conduct towards the preceptors, your selfrestraint and devotion to the virtuous are all in keeping with those born in the race of Raghu.

40005500.author: पदार्थः
40005500.content: ते your, मनस्थम् feelings of your heart, एतत् this, जाने च I am aware, दृढीकरणम् अस्तु let it be confirmed, इति in this manner, (तव your), कीर्तिम् fame, अत्यर्थम् greatly, समभिवर्धयन् to increase it, त्वाम् you, अपृच्छम् I asked.

40005500.author: Translation
40005500.content: I am aware of the feelings in your heart. Even then I enquired in order to confirm it  and to further your fame.

40005501.author: पदार्थः
40005501.content: धर्मज्ञम् knower of righteousness (Rama), ससीतम् with Sita, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, जाने च I know, असौ ते भ्राता this your brother, चित्रकूटे in Chitrakuta, महागिरौ mountain, वसति is living.

40005501.author: Translation
40005501.content: I know your brother who is conversant with righteousness is living on Chitrakuta mountain with Sita and Lakshmana.

40005502.author: पदार्थः
40005502.content: तं देशम् to that place, श्वः tomorow, गन्तासि shall go, अद्य today, मन्त्रिभिस्सह along with  ministers, वस you may stay, सुप्राज्ञ O supremely sagacious prince, कामार्थकोविद who is aware of kama (desire) and artha (prosperity), मे my, एतम् this, कामं desire, कुरु fulfil.

40005502.author: Translation
40005502.content: O supremely sagacious prince gifted with the knowledge of kama (desire) and artha (wealth), tomorrow you go, but to night stay here with your ministers and fulfil my desire.

40005503.author: पदार्थः
40005503.content: उदारदर्शनः a man of liberal outlook, भरतः Bharata, प्रतीतरूपः expressing his intention, ततः then, तथा be it so, इत्येवम् saying, वचः words, अब्रवीत् said, तदा then, नराधिपात्मजः son of the king, तदाश्रमे in that hermitage, निशानिवासाय to spend the night, बुद्धिम् decision, चकार made.

40005503.author: Translation
40005503.content: A man of liberal disposition, Bharata expressed his intention, saying, 'Be it so'. Then the prince made up him mind to spend the might in that hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
